literal: Whatever they guard not even if, tongue let them guard; if they guard not, they will grieve, word-slip having caught in.
translation: Even if they guard nothing else, let them guard their tongue. If they do not, they will suffer, caught in a slip of words.
modern: எவற்றைக் காக்கவில்லை என்றாலும் நாவையாவது காக்க வேண்டும். காக்கத் தவறினால் சொற்குற்றத்தில் சிக்கித் துன்பப்படுவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the supreme importance of controlling one's speech. The word 'யா' means 'whatever', suggesting that even if a person fails to exercise restraint in other areas, they must at least control their tongue ('நா'). If they fail to do so ('காவாக்கால்'), they will inevitably make a slip of the tongue ('சொல் இழுக்கு'). Such careless words will cause them to suffer grief ('சோகாப்பர்') from the resulting consequences.
